description: This file defines the main activity and composable UI components for the Android TV frontend of a streaming platform, including header, hero banner, sections with posters and TV channels, and various UI elements with focus and accessibility features.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity that sets up the app's theme and content view, displaying the HomeScreen composable.

methods.name: HomeScreen
methods.description: Composable that constructs the main home screen layout, including header, hero banner, and content sections.

methods.name: HeaderBar
methods.description: Composable for the top header with logo, navigation pills, search icons, and avatar.

methods.name: SearchIconGroup
methods.description: Creates a group of overlapping SVG images to represent the search icon.

methods.name: FocusablePillText
methods.description: A focusable, selectable text pill for navigation, with focus styling.

methods.name: LogoGroup
methods.description: Builds the small layered logo from multiple SVG components.

methods.name: SvgImage
methods.description: Displays an SVG image using the custom SvgImage composable.

methods.name: SvgOrImage
methods.description: Loads either an SVG or PNG image based on the filename.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Displays a TV channel with overlay, play button, progress bar, and details.
